analysis.title: Top Stories (McKeon, Jack), 5 Nov 2026
key_insights: BOE raised rates as expected on a vote of 8-1.
Gold positioning: speculators are returning after two months of pullback. The note ties this to the Democratic sweep raising hopes for an end to the Iran war and tempering Fed rate-hike expectations.
Oil industry is bracing for Democrats to use their new political strength to push for a windfall tax on surging crude prices, per people familiar (BBG).
Iran war and midterms: President Trump conceded that the war cost Republicans dearly in the midterms. He must decide whether to seek a deal or return to bombing.

Red Sea: after Houthi attacks on Saudi oil tankers and the seizure of territory commanding the Bab al-Mandeb chokepoint, Saudi Arabia asked the Houthis what a negotiated halt would take. The reported answer was $51 billion (WSJ).
China blocked the sale of ABB's robotics unit to SoftBank, a setback for SoftBank's plan to expand into physical AI (BBG).
Micron suspended plans for a memory chip plant in Taiwan because of a labor dispute, which puts the future of a major production base for AI components in question (BBG).
Data center build-out: Meta President Dina Powell McCormick said building data centers will be harder after the midterms, though perhaps not as hard as it now appears (WSJ).
China is considering selling dollar and offshore yuan denominated bonds as early as this month, as it seeks a larger presence in international debt markets (BBG).
Politics: the House could vote to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth as soon as next week as Republicans turn against him (CNN).
Overnight data: Philippines October inflation rose to +7.8% Y/Y against consensus of +7.6%. Sweden and Taiwan October CPI came in below consensus.
US initial jobless claims are due at 8:30 am ET with a consensus estimate of 196k against 194k prior. Fed speakers Hammack, Barkin and Logan appear today.

Rating changes of note: Cisco cut to Equal-Weight at Morgan Stanley (PT $120), Skyworks cut to Equal-Weight at Barclays after results, Union Pacific cut to Neutral at Baird (PT $310), Vistra cut at KeyBanc on Texas policy questions after the midterms, HubSpot cut to Sector Weight at KeyBanc.

Rating upgrades of note: Frontier and JetBlue both raised to Buy at Deutsche Bank, Cinemark raised to Overweight at Morgan Stanley (PT $50), Wayfair raised to Buy at Gordon Haskett (PT $160), Labcorp raised to Buy at HSBC (PT $410).
